name: Are pocket listings more common in certain areas within your service region?

mainEntity.name: Are pocket listings more common in certain areas within your service region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pocket listings can be found across our service areas, but they tend to be more prevalent in high-demand, affluent communities or areas with a strong luxury market where privacy is highly valued. This includes locales like Fisher Island, Key Biscayne, or areas along the coast in Palm Beach County. A contextual relevance point is that the prevalence often correlates with the concentration of high-net-worth individuals and properties that benefit from a discreet marketing approach, allowing us to leverage our specific network in these regions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pocket listings are found across our service areas but are often more common in affluent, high-demand luxury markets like Fisher Island or coastal Palm Beach County, where privacy is valued.
